evidence_boundary: Nodes and edges are transcribed from the OpenAI public announcement and a public proof-outline discussion; the complete 166-page proof artifact was not available to this run. No node is claimed to be a complete formal proof subsystem.

nodes.name: Self-similar concentrating background
assumptions: similarity coordinates and concentration parameter are defined
constructed background has the claimed singular growth
nodes.internal_construction: A concentrating, axisymmetric background flow is described in similarity variables.
nodes.exported_object: background velocity/pressure fields and their induced momentum residual
nodes.validation_condition: check the fields and scaling satisfy the stated local regularity, support, and growth conditions

nodes.name: Residual represented as stress
assumptions: Navier–Stokes residual can be expressed as a stress divergence
nodes.internal_construction: Rewrite the background momentum residual as the divergence of a stress supported in an annulus.
nodes.exported_object: stress tensor T and its support/moment constraints
nodes.validation_condition: verify the divergence identity, support, and matching constraints

nodes.name: Oscillatory pulse families
assumptions: stress lies in an admissible realization region
localized divergence-free pulses can be constructed
nodes.internal_construction: Construct localized oscillatory pulse families with prescribed scales, amplitudes, and disjoint auxiliary supports.
nodes.exported_object: pulse fields and quadratic momentum-flux covariances
nodes.validation_condition: verify divergence-free structure, localization, scale bounds, and absence of forbidden cross-terms

nodes.name: Stress realization and leading cancellation
assumptions: pulse covariance vectors span the required stress cone
amplitude coefficients satisfy the declared positivity conditions
nodes.internal_construction: Choose pulse amplitudes so averaged quadratic flux realizes the target stress and cancels its leading divergence.
nodes.exported_object: realized stress cancellation plus new residual terms
nodes.validation_condition: verify the averaged flux identity and quantify the residual after cancellation

nodes.name: Iterative correction cycle
assumptions: new residual admits the stated correction operators
decay exponent improves on each pass
nodes.internal_construction: Repeat wave-amplitude, stress, mean, and moment corrections while tracking shrinking cutoffs and residual decay.
nodes.exported_object: corrected fields and residual flatness estimates
nodes.validation_condition: verify each correction identity and convergence/flatness claim under the declared norms

nodes.name: Localization and theorem conclusion
assumptions: flat residual extends smoothly through the singular time
nodes.internal_construction: Apply compact cutoffs, define the force from the final residual, establish energy control, and transport the construction to the torus.
nodes.exported_object: localized solution, smooth force, energy bound, and theorem-level conclusion
nodes.validation_condition: verify smooth extension, support, energy, uniqueness, and rescaling/periodization conditions
